endorsements.name: SeungJin 'Beist' Lee
endorsements.label: Hacking, Surveilling, and Deceiving victims on Smart TV
endorsements.description: Smart TVs sold over 80,000,000 units around the world in 2012. This next generation "smart" platform is becoming more and more popular. On the other hand, we hardly see security research on Smart TVs. This presentation will cover vulnerabilities we've found on the platform.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2013

evidence-links.title: Black Hat USA 2013 - Hacking, Surveilling, and Deceiving victims on Smart TV

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
